description: Flat metadata schema for individual records describing synthesized herbicide compounds, their molecular characterization, physicochemical properties, and in vitro bioactivity/toxicity assay results against plant enzymes and cellular pathways.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual metadata record or assay result row.

compound_id.descr: Unique identifier for the herbicide compound.

compound_name.descr: Common or internal name of the compound, if available.

compound_class.descr: Chemical class or scaffold of the herbicide candidate, e.g., triazine, sulfonylurea, pyridine.

smiles.descr: Canonical or isomeric SMILES string representing the compound structure.

inchi.descr: InChI string representing the compound structure, if available.

inchi_key.descr: Standard InChIKey identifier for the compound, if available.

molecular_formula.descr: Empirical molecular formula of the compound.

purity_percent.descr: Compound purity as measured experimentally, in percent (%).

synthesis_date.descr: Date the compound was synthesized or isolated.

synthesis_method.descr: Brief description or code for the synthetic route used to generate the compound.

batch_id.descr: Identifier for the synthesis batch or lot.

characterization_status.descr: Whether molecular identity/characterization was completed, e.g., complete, partial, pending.

nmr_method.descr: NMR method used for characterization, e.g., 1H NMR, 13C NMR, 2D NMR.

nmr_solvent.descr: Solvent used for NMR analysis, e.g., CDCl3, DMSO-d6.

nmr_field_strength_mhz.descr: NMR spectrometer field strength in MHz.

nmr_result_summary.descr: Summary of NMR characterization findings, such as structural confirmation notes or key peaks.

ms_method.descr: Mass spectrometry method used, e.g., ESI-MS, MALDI-TOF, GC-MS.

ms_ion_mode.descr: Ionization mode used in MS analysis, e.g., positive, negative.

ms_observed_mz.descr: Observed mass-to-charge ratio for the primary ion peak.

ms_expected_mz.descr: Expected or theoretical mass-to-charge ratio for the target ion.

ms_accuracy_ppm.descr: Mass accuracy error in parts per million (ppm), if reported.

logp.descr: Octanol-water partition coefficient or estimated logP value.

solubility_mg_ml.descr: Measured solubility in mg/mL under the stated conditions, if available.

melting_point_c.descr: Melting point in degrees Celsius, if measured.

assay_id.descr: Unique identifier for the bioactivity assay or experiment.

assay_name.descr: Name of the bioactivity assay, e.g., enzyme inhibition assay, cell viability assay.

assay_type.descr: Assay category, e.g., enzyme, cellular pathway, cytotoxicity.

assay_protocol_id.descr: Reference identifier for the assay protocol or SOP used.

target_name.descr: Name of the plant enzyme, pathway, or biological target tested.

target_type.descr: Target category, e.g., enzyme, pathway, receptor, whole-cell phenotype.

species_name.descr: Plant species associated with the target, cell line, or biological source used in testing.

species_taxonomy_id.descr: Taxonomic identifier for the plant species, if available.

cell_or_tissue_type.descr: Cell type, tissue, or biological material used in the assay.

assay_format.descr: Experimental format, e.g., in vitro, cell-based, microsomal, biochemical.

concentration_tested.descr: Applied compound concentration in the assay, in µM or as specified in the accompanying concentration unit field.

concentration_unit.descr: Unit for compound concentration, e.g., µM, nM, mg/L.

response_value.descr: Measured assay response value, such as % inhibition, viability, fluorescence, absorbance, or enzyme activity.

response_unit.descr: Unit for the measured response value, e.g., %, RFU, OD, activity units.

potency_metric.descr: Primary potency metric, e.g., IC50, EC50, Ki, percent inhibition at fixed dose.

potency_value.descr: Numeric value of the potency metric.

potency_unit.descr: Unit for the potency metric, e.g., nM, µM, mg/L.

selectivity_index.descr: Selectivity ratio or index comparing activity on-target versus off-target or between species/targets.

toxicity_value.descr: Numeric toxicity readout, such as CC50, LC50, growth inhibition, or cell death percentage.

toxicity_unit.descr: Unit for the toxicity readout, e.g., nM, µM, %, mg/L.

bioactivity_class.descr: Qualitative classification of activity, e.g., active, inactive, weakly active, selectively active, toxic.

is_active.descr: Boolean flag indicating whether the compound met the predefined activity threshold.

is_toxic.descr: Boolean flag indicating whether the compound showed toxic effects under the assay conditions.

replicate_count.descr: Number of technical or biological replicates included in the reported result.

mean_response.descr: Mean response across replicates, if summarized.

std_response.descr: Standard deviation of the response across replicates, if summarized.

control_type.descr: Type of control used, e.g., vehicle, positive control, negative control.

control_name.descr: Name or identifier of the control compound or condition.

assay_ph.descr: pH of the assay buffer or medium.

incubation_time_h.descr: Incubation time in hours for the assay.

organism_growth_stage.descr: Growth stage or developmental stage of the plant material, if relevant.

application_purpose.descr: Intended evaluation purpose, e.g., herbicidal potency screening, selectivity profiling, toxicity assessment.

agricultural_relevance_notes.descr: Brief notes on potential agricultural relevance, selectivity considerations, or development status.
